name: Al Fahidi Historical Neighbourhood
description: Preserved 19th-century district with gypsum and coral buildings, art galleries, and wind towers.

name: Dubai Museum & Al Fahidi Fort
description: Historic defense fort built in 1787 showcasing Dubai's transformation from fishing village to metropolis.

name: Al Shindagha Museum & Perfume House
description: World-class open-air museum along Dubai Creek chronicling Emirati maritime heritage and royal history.

name: Sheikh Saeed Al Maktoum House
description: Historic official residence of former Dubai rulers with vast archives of rare photographs and coins.

name: Dubai Coffee Museum
description: Charming heritage villa dedicated to regional and international coffee roasting traditions with live tastings.

name: Coins Museum Bur Dubai
description: Eight exhibition rooms displaying nearly 500 historic coins across ancient Islamic caliphates.

name: Bur Dubai Textile Souk
description: Covered traditional bazaar packed with silk rolls, cashmere scarves, handmade pashminas, and local tailors.

name: Al Seef Heritage Waterfront
description: A picturesque 1.8km waterfront development bridging traditional mud-brick Emirati architecture with modern cafes.

name: Dubai Gold Souk
description: World-famous traditional market with over 380 jewelry retailers displaying tax-free gold, diamonds, and gems.

name: Dubai Spice Souk
description: Aromatic narrow alleyways offering saffron, za'atar, dried frankincense, sumac, and exotic teas.

name: Naif Souk & Heritage Center
description: Lively local bazaar famous for abayas, textiles, leather goods, and authentic regional street commerce.

name: Heritage House & Al Ahmadiya School
description: Dubai's first semi-formal national school founded in 1912 alongside a restored wealthy pearl merchant's house.

name: Dubai Creek Abra Ride
description: Historic motorized wooden water boat crossing Dubai Creek between Deira and Bur Dubai for just 1 AED.

name: Al Mamzar Beach Park
description: Expansive 106-hectare park with five pristine sheltered beach coves, picnic groves, and swimming pools.

name: Burj Khalifa At The Top (Levels 124 & 125)
description: World's tallest building observation decks with 360-degree panoramic views of Dubai and the Arabian Gulf.

name: The Dubai Fountain Show
description: Choreographed musical fountain display set on Burj Lake with jets shooting water up to 140 meters high.

name: The Dubai Mall & Chinatown
description: One of the world's largest retail and entertainment complexes with over 1,200 shops, Olympic ice rink, and food courts.

name: Dubai Aquarium & Underwater Zoo
description: 10-million liter tank containing over 33,000 aquatic animals and a 48-meter walk-through tunnel.

name: Sky Views Dubai & Glass Slide
description: Futuristic observatory 219.5 meters above ground featuring transparent glass floor walks and an exterior glass slide.

name: Dubai Opera
description: Dhow-shaped architectural masterpiece hosting opera, ballet, West End musicals, and architectural backstage tours.

name: Souk Al Bahar
description: Arabesque marketplace adjacent to Dubai Mall with stone walkways, craft stalls, and lakefront restaurants.

name: Museum of the Future
description: Torus-shaped architectural wonder adorned with Arabic calligraphy, showcasing speculative technological innovations for 2071.

name: Dubai Frame
description: 150-meter-tall golden picture frame in Zabeel Park framing views of historic Old Dubai north and modern New Dubai south.

name: Etihad Museum
description: Magnificent dynamic museum on Union House grounds commemorating the 1971 founding of the United Arab Emirates.

name: Jumeirah Mosque Tour
description: Fatimid-style white stone mosque welcoming non-Muslim visitors through guided cultural tours under 'Open Doors, Open Minds'.

name: Kite Beach
description: Vibrant public beach renowned for kitesurfing, beach volleyball, seaside running tracks, and gourmet food trucks.

name: Sunset Beach (Umm Suqeim)
description: Quiet stretch of sand offering the quintessential photo backdrop of the sail-shaped Burj Al Arab hotel.

name: La Mer Beach & North Promenade
description: Urban beachfront destination blending graffiti street art, wooden boardwalks, and seaside relaxation.

name: Madinat Jumeirah Souk & Canals
description: Recreation of an ancient Arabian marketplace with fragrant spice stalls, water canals, and abra boat tours.

name: Mall of the Emirates
description: Premier shopping center housing over 600 global brands, luxury fashion dome, and international dining.

name: Ski Dubai Snow Park
description: 22,500 square meter indoor snow wonderland with real sub-zero ski slopes, bobsled rides, and penguin encounters.

name: Al Barsha Pond Park
description: Serene 50-acre green park centered around a massive freshwater pond with solar-powered swan pedal boats.

name: Dubai Miracle Garden
description: World's largest natural flower garden displaying over 150 million blooming flowers sculpted into castles and an Emirates A380.

name: Dubai Butterfly Garden
description: Ten custom climate-controlled domes hosting over 15,000 live exotic butterflies from 50 species.

name: Dubai Marina Walk
description: 7km tree-lined waterfront promenade with glimmering luxury superyachts, illuminated skyscrapers, and outdoor cafes.

name: JBR The Beach & The Walk
description: Bustling cosmopolitan beach destination featuring camel rides, open-air cinema, watersports, and retail pop-ups.

name: Dubai Marina Dhow Cruise Dinner
description: Two-hour evening cruise on a traditional illuminated glass-enclosed boat through Dubai Marina with international buffet.

name: XLine Dubai Marina Zipline
description: World's longest urban zipline propelling riders belly-down at 80 km/h from 170 meters high across Marina waters.

name: Marina Mall Dubai
description: Relaxed community shopping mall along the marina waterfront with 140 shops, cinema, and water taxi access.

name: Ain Dubai (Bluewaters Island Plaza)
description: Pedestrian walkway linking JBR to Bluewaters Island offering scenic viewpoints of the world's largest observation wheel.

name: The View at The Palm (Level 52)
description: Observation deck perched 240 meters above the Palm Tower offering unobstructed views of Palm Jumeirah and the Arabian Gulf.

name: Aquaventure Waterpark
description: World's largest waterpark at Atlantis featuring 105 record-breaking waterslides and private beach access.

name: The Lost Chambers Aquarium
description: Mythological underwater ruin labyrinth holding over 65,000 marine animals including sharks, rays, and seahorses.

name: Palm West Beach
description: 1.6km beach promenade lined with 300 palm trees, dog-friendly sands, watersports, and Dubai Marina skyline views.

name: Nakheel Mall & Rooftop Garden
description: Palm Jumeirah's central retail venue with direct monorail access, 300+ stores, and rooftop fine dining.

name: The Pointe & Boardwalk
description: Scenic waterfront destination situated at the tip of the Palm trunk with direct sunset views of Atlantis.

name: Dubai Garden Glow & Dinosaur Park
description: Luminescent theme park crafted with 10 million energy-saving bulbs and 100+ animatronic roaring dinosaurs.

name: Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary (Flamingo Hide)
description: Protected wetland reserve hosting tens of thousands of migratory pink flamingos viewed from wooden observation hides.

name: Dubai Canal Boardwalk & Waterfall
description: 3.2km illuminated water canal with pedestrian suspension bridges and a motion-sensing mechanical waterfall.

name: Global Village Dubai
description: Massive seasonal multi-cultural festival park with 30 pavilions representing 90 cultures, street food, and fireworks.

name: IMG Worlds of Adventure
description: Mega-indoor themed entertainment park spanning 1.5 million square feet with Marvel, Cartoon Network, and dinosaur rollercoasters.

name: Safa Park & Boating Lake
description: Sprawling heritage public park established in 1975 with manicured lawns, cycling paths, and Burj Khalifa vistas.
